_prompt_descriptive_v0: Our transcript redaction both misses and over-scrubs in places. Docker/Kubernetes-shaped secrets like MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD, MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD, MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD, and DB__PASSWORD pass through unredacted, and an ADO.NET connection string whose password is quoted with embedded semicolons (Password="se;cret;here") leaks the value. At the same time, obvious documentation placeholders such as DB_PASSWORD=<password> or DB_PASSWORD=***** get scrubbed as if they were real secrets, while flattened dotted config keys like db.password aren't caught at all. Restore correct behavior across these cases without regressing existing redaction or introducing new over-redaction. Keep the fix minimal.
